title: Fix a posted transaction
summary: How to change the account of a transaction you have already posted, one at a time or several at once.

steps.text: Click Transactions in the sidebar, and find the transaction. Search by a word or an amount if there are many.

image.description: The Transactions list with sample data. In the first row the account list is open, to choose another account. The other rows show their account's name with Change underneath.

steps.text: Click Change under its account, and choose the right account. The GST is worked out again from that account's usual GST code.
Click the row to see the transaction. Its History says what changed and when.
Click Select, and tick the transactions you want to move.
Choose the account under Move to, and click Move. Each one is changed on its own, with its own history.

sections.heading: If something goes wrong
paragraphs: There is no Change: the transaction is shared across several accounts, such as a split, or it is in a locked period. A locked one says Locked, because its BAS is done.
You chose the wrong account: click Change again and choose the right one.
